verses.html: 2 After six days Jesus took with Him Peter, James, and John, and led them up a high mountain by themselves. There He was transfigured before them.
verses.text: 2 After six days Jesus took with Him Peter, James, and John, and led them up a high mountain by themselves. There He was transfigured before them.

verses.html: 3 His clothes became radiantly white, brighter than any launderer on earth could bleach them.

verses.html: 4 And Elijah and Moses appeared before them, talking with Jesus.

verses.html: 5 Peter said to Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
verses.text: 5 Peter said to Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

verses.html: 6 For they were all so terrified that Peter did not know what else to say.

verses.html: 7 Then a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and a voice came from the cloud: “This is My beloved Son. Listen to Him!”

verses.html: 8 Suddenly, when they looked around, they saw no one with them except Jesus.

verses.html: 9 As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus admonished them not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

verses.html: 10 So they kept this matter to themselves, discussing what it meant to rise from the dead.

verses.html: 12 He replied, “Elijah does indeed come first, and he restores all things. Why then is it written that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected?
verses.text: 12 He replied, “Elijah does indeed come first, and he restores all things. Why then is it written that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected?

verses.html: 13 But I tell you that Elijah has indeed come, and they have done to him whatever they wished, just as it is written about him.”
verses.text: 13 But I tell you that Elijah has indeed come, and they have done to him whatever they wished, just as it is written about him.”

verses.html: 2 Six days later, Jesus climbed up a tall mountain. He had Peter, James, and John go with him. No one else was with them. Then, the three apprentices saw Jesus change how he appeared.

verses.html: 11 Then those three apprentices asked Jesus, “The teachers of the Jewish law tell us that the prophet Elijah has to be here before {the Messiah gets here}. Are they right about that?”

verses.html: 12 Jesus replied, “{Yes, the prophet} Elijah must be here before {the Messiah gets here}. He will make everything as it should be. However, consider this: {the prophets} wrote in the Scriptures that people would reject me, the Son of Man, and hurt me very much.
verses.text: 12 Jesus replied, “{Yes, the prophet} Elijah must be here before {the Messiah gets here}. He will make everything as it should be. However, consider this: {the prophets} wrote in the Scriptures that people would reject me, the Son of Man, and hurt me very much.

verses.html: 13 {That makes sense only because of} what I am about to tell you. {The prophet} Elijah has already been here. Further, people treated him badly, just as {the prophets} wrote in the Scriptures about him.”
